units.*_food: integer food units during the indicated year

method.baseline: First production-year soil and active farmers from the same seed and region.
method.soil: Use year-one soil_before. This is the soil entering production after any public works and before annual erosion/recovery.
method.workers: Use year-one active farmers capped by current effective land slots and current total sector workers. No other sector is simulated.
method.constants: All other factors use the observed year, including actual climate, productivity, technology, soil or labor as applicable, and observed equipment intensity.
method.calculation: Each region separately rounds down 32 × farmers × soil × productivity × technology × fertility × climate × equipment × farm_multiplier / (10 × 1000^7). Sum afterward.
method.meaning: Each difference is a separate one-year arithmetic sensitivity. The two differences can overlap. They do not constitute an additive decomposition or a causal long-run intervention.
method.tax: Observed taxes are post-harvest transfers. Excess is max(0, levy − observed private surplus above the protected reserve) per region. This tests reserve compliance only, not the welfare effect of taxation.
method.cohorts: Development seeds 0–19 and holdout seeds 20–39. Values below are sums across 20 worlds at the named year, not cumulative over time.
